main.description: A player's whole Harvestipol farm — the single save record (rkey `self`, one farm per repo). The `farm` blob is the deterministic game state (bed with free-position plants and wall-clock `at` timestamps, seed bag, pantry, planetary metals, preparations, gacha collection, mine progress, stats). Growth is a pure function of (plant, crop, now, tendCount), so any client — including a keyless public viewer — recomputes the live field from this record alone. Open-shaped: the engine versions the blob with `farm.v`.

farm.description: The engine save (farm/js/state.js shape, versioned by farm.v).
